subject: Materials Science
title: Thermoplastic Matrices: Recyclable Composites
description: A short lesson to help you apply Thermoplastic Matrices: Recyclable Composites.

hook.text: Thermoset composites can't be recycled by melting. Thermoplastic composites can — and that matters.

buildup.text: Thermoplastic matrices — PEEK, PPS, nylon — melt and solidify repeatedly without degrading.

discovery.text: They're tougher than thermosets — cracks don't propagate as easily through a ductile matrix.

twist.text: Processing requires high temperatures and pressures — making them more expensive to manufacture.

climax.text: Airbus uses thermoplastic composite fuselage panels that can be welded, not riveted.

punchline.text: Melt it, shape it, fly it — then melt it again.

quiz.question: What advantage do thermoplastic matrices have over thermosets?
options: They can be remelted and recycled
They cure faster at room temperature
